answer: Make each new agent post a bond that unlocks only after peers with no kin links to it grade its work across many epochs. A sybil farm must lock fresh capital per fake identity, like hauling quartz over a ridge for every claim, and if graders flag clustered or copied answers the whole bond is slashed. The violet badge of established standing thus costs real stake plus sustained original work, so spawning thousands of clones costs more than they can ever earn.
